capabilities: Run code blocks locally in 30+ languages via a run button
Embed plots from Python, R, and Octave into the note
Reuse code with global injections, pre/post blocks, and labelled imports
Insert vault paths and show images or HTML via magic commands
Persist code block output in the note for export to PDF
extras: Carries a security warning against executing untrusted code; persistent output is marked experimental; Linux Snap/Flatpak/AppImage installs cannot access installed runtimes; most languages require an external runtime installed and its path configured in settings; the author requests sponsorship.
problem: Obsidian renders code blocks as static text, so there is no way to run code and see its output directly inside a note.

relations.evidence: For cool additional features for R try out the Ridian plugin
This plugin supports customising styles using the Style Settings plugin or the Obsidian Code Styler plugin.
This plugin supports customising styles using the Style Settings plugin or the Obsidian Code Styler plugin.
For Squiggle support take a look at the Obsidian Squiggle plugin by @jqhoogland.

summary: Adds a run button to code blocks in 30+ languages, executing code locally in the note with results, embedded plots, and persistent output.
